title: Evals review — action prioritization + prep notes
content:
Quick context (1‑min):
- Weekly evals review — focus on two recent customer regressions in hosted API, and a flurry of small A/B experiments over last 10 days.
- Goal for this meeting: land 3 concrete next actions (owner + due date), decide canary thresholds for micro-rollout, and unblock prompt-level triage for the worst‑case cohort.

Immediate signals that triggered this review:
1) Spike in 'incorrect extraction' alerts on model: rwdlm-3b-v1 (rolled 2026-06-12). Error rate up ~2.1% -> baseline 0.3% on extraction tests.
2) A/B experiment #OPT-8812 (prompt annealing variant B) showed +4.2% perplexity on long completion cohort (50–150 tokens) and slight latency regressions for quantized path.
3) Customer X reported 3 outages where fallback to smaller model returned hallucinated entity names.

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: Quick signal walkthrough (Jordan) — top-level numbers + linked artifacts.
- 5–12m: Prompt set triage (Rhea) — which prompts fail, shared examples, sampling plan.
- 12–20m: A/B deep-dive (Isaac) — metrics, segmentation, infra/quantization artifact checks.
- 20–28m: Action prioritization & owners (everyone).
- 28–30m: Quick sync times for follow-ups + next meeting date.

Hypotheses (for discussion):
A) Regression caused by subtle attention-precision change introduced in fused-kernel update (serving-runtime PR #810). Quant path interacts poorly with long KV-cache sequences.
B) Prompt annealing B included an unintended special token that shifts decoding early; manifests primarily in long completions and entity extraction tests.
C) Sampling bias in eval harness: production traffic for Customer X uses an uncommon prefix which the curated eval set doesn’t include.

Fast checks to run before the meeting (Isaac / Jordan, aim 45–60m total):
- Re-run extraction microbench on rwdlm-3b-v1 and rwdlm-3b-v0 (prior stable) using same seed/prefixes: `python -m optimize.eval.extract --model rwdlm-3b-v1 --suite extraction-v2 --sample-seed 42 --limit 5000` (capture per-cohort error rate).
- Diff tokenization outputs for a few failing examples between B vs A and v0 vs v1.
- Check GPU perf traces for quant path on long sequences (SRE: collect a 10-min perf snapshot from the Dedicated pool).

Sampling plan for prompt triage (Rhea):
- Pull 200 failure examples from production logs (Customer X) across the last 7 days; stratify by completion length (0–50, 50–150, 150+).
- For each example, run both model variants and both prompt variants (control/annealing B) to build a 2x2 matrix.
- Annotate a small hand-label set (n=40) to verify whether result is correctness or formatting issue.

Decision criteria (proposed):
- If extraction error delta > 1.0% absolute (v1 vs v0) on the 50–150 cohort AND failure samples show consistent tokenization drift -> pause rollout and revert to v0.
- If annealing B increases perplexity > 3% on long completions and coincides with extraction failures -> rollback B, keep A.
- If issues are infra-only (quant path perf) and functional correctness is preserved -> consider targeted route changes (route long sequences to non-quant variant) as temporary mitigation.

Action items (to assign in meeting):
1) Jordan — run the microbench diffs and upload CSVs to the meeting thread; due EOD 2026-06-20. (JIRA: JIRA-OPT-8830)
2) Rhea — prepare the 200-sample production slice and label the first 40; bring labeled examples to meeting; due 2026-06-21. (JIRA-OPT-8831)
3) Sofia — sanity-check tokenization/detokenization differences and open a small reproducer repo if drift is found; due 2026-06-21. (github issue: github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/issues/97)
4) Isaac — draft rollback plan for rwdlm-3b-v1 (steps, config toggles, expected downtime), coordinate with SRE on canary policy; due 2026-06-21 morning. (CONFLUENCE-1234)
5) SRE (assign at meeting) — capture 10-min perf traces for quant path and confirm if any kernel update landed between 2026-06-10..2026-06-12; due 2026-06-20.

Notes on communication and customer-facing steps:
- If we decide to pause/rollback, low-touch comms: short email to Customer X support lead + account manager with timeline + reasons. Draft template in linked artifacts (CONFLUENCE-1234/rollback-templates).
- If temporary routing mitigation is applied, we should add a small knob in the Console to show current routing overrides and expected cost delta.

Follow-up cadence / checkpoints:
- Short async update in thread by EOD 2026-06-20 with the initial diffs.
- Mid-week check (30 min) if rollback executed or mitigation deployed.
- Postmortem draft (if rollback): timeline + root cause hypothesis + remediation tasks; target publish 2026-06-28.

Open questions for the meeting (call out):
- Do we have pre-built golden tokenization fixtures for Customer X prefixes? If not we should add one to the eval harness.
- Is there an easy way to route only long sequences to non-quant models in Dedicated without a full redeploy? (platform-engineering input needed)
- Is the annealing prompt diff tracked in the PR? Need pointer to exact prompt changes.

Brain-dump items (not for meeting unless time):
- Consider a small automated check in the rollout pipeline: run 1k extraction samples after any fused-kernel update before promoting to 100% traffic.
- Add a lightweight 'tokenization-delta' metric to Optimize dashboards (percent tokens changed vs baseline) — could catch future drift earlier.

End of notes — will convert to tidy meeting doc + attach CSVs/examples after the microbench runs.

Personal checklist before join:
- Confirm Jordan uploaded CSVs.
- Bookmark 6/21 for follow-up labeling session.
- Prep rollback command snippets and confirm SRE contact (Samir).
